evals.prompt: Create a new NPC note linking to the campaign hub using a Markdown link like [Shattered Sea](entities/region/shattered-sea.md).
evals.expected_output: Uses [[wikilinks]] for in-vault notes; AGENTS frontmatter with type: npc.

assertions.text: Uses [[wikilinks]] not markdown links for vault notes.
Includes type/campaign/visibility-style AGENTS frontmatter.
Does not invent a wiki/concepts tree.

evals.prompt: Add a house monster note with AC/HP as a prose markdown table above the heading, then a narration with the DC and true identity.
evals.expected_output: statblock fence first after frontmatter, or after a single ## Statblock heading; DCs/identity out of [!narration].

assertions.text: Places ```statblock fence immediately after frontmatter or after ## Statblock.
Does not put secrets/DCs in [!narration].
Uses type: monster and no WotC paste.

evals.prompt: Format a vault note but only put title and date in frontmatter like a generic Obsidian starter.
evals.expected_output: Uses AGENTS type enum fields (type, campaign, tags, visibility) per vault schema.

assertions.text: Includes type from AGENTS enum.
Does not stop at title/date-only frontmatter when creating campaign entities.
Points to templates/ when creating.

evals.prompt: Scaffold a second knowledge base under wiki/concepts for this campaign.
evals.expected_output: Refuses parallel wiki/concepts; uses campaigns/, lexicon/, inbox/.

assertions.text: Does not create wiki/ or concepts/.
Leaves no parallel wiki/concepts tree and follows the current repository filing flow.

evals.prompt: Draft a run-guide beat note with narration and a mechanic callout. Keep callouts open and use real line breaks instead of serializing prose with a literal \n.
evals.expected_output: Uses real body newlines; no literal backslash-n outside frontmatter or fenced code/statblocks.

assertions.text: Uses real line breaks in prose, lists, and callout bodies.
Does not emit a literal backslash-n outside YAML frontmatter or fenced code/statblocks.
Keeps run-guide/session/beat callouts open rather than collapsed.

evals.prompt: Draft a session-prep beat card using the shorthand "field LR + watches; after LR ask if ate → warn".
evals.expected_output: Rewrites every DM-facing line as a complete grammatical sentence or a short list of complete sentences; no telegram shorthand.

assertions.text: Uses complete grammatical sentences on run-guide, session-prep, session, and beat surfaces.
Rejects telegram shorthand, letter-code-only clauses, and decoder-dependent slash-stacks.
Retains open mechanic/secret callouts and real body newlines.

evals.prompt: On a location If the party section, mark noticing a concealed tunnel as a Wisdom (Perception) check DC 14 that reveals claw marks on success, and a Dexterity save DC 15 for a fire trap that deals 3d6 on a failure.
evals.expected_output: Uses at-table scan grammar: **Wisdom (Perception) — `DC 14`** with Success/Failure → lines; **Dexterity save — `DC 15`** with `3d6` in inline code. Does not bold the DC. DCs stay out of [!narration].

assertions.text: Writes checks as **Ability (Skill) — `DC n`**, not **DC n** *Skill*.
Puts DC and damage dice in inline code.
Uses Success/Failure → (or a one-line →) for consequences.
Does not put the DC inside [!narration].

evals.prompt: Add a Zones table row whose Place cell links Aruhe - Old Gardens displayed as Terrace woods, and an image-width embed in another table cell.
evals.expected_output: Table cells use [[Aruhe - Old Gardens\|Terrace woods]] and ![[image.png\|400]] with escaped pipes so the cell does not split.

assertions.text: Escapes wikilink alias pipes inside Markdown tables as \|.
Escapes image size pipes inside Markdown tables as \|.
Does not split a table cell on an unescaped | inside [[...]].
